preview.overview: Notre Dame brings the College Football Belt to Ross-Ade Stadium looking to extend its dominance over Purdue, a program the Fighting Irish have thoroughly controlled in recent matchups. The belt is on the line as Notre Dame arrives in West Lafayette riding an impressive five-game winning streak with dominant margins, while Purdue has struggled considerably and lost four of its last five games.
key_matchups: Notre Dame's explosive offense vs. Purdue's porous defense that has allowed 56, 49, and 34 points in three of its last four games
Purdue's need to establish early offensive rhythm against a Notre Dame defense that has held all recent opponents to 27 points or fewer
Field position and turnover battle—Purdue cannot afford mistakes against a team that has won by an average of 41.8 points in its last five games
preview.betting_angles: Notre Dame has won 61 of 89 all-time meetings and has been dominant in the recent era, outscoring Purdue by a combined 130 points across their last two matchups (56-30 and 66-7). The recency of form heavily favors the Irish, who are averaging 48 points per game while Purdue is allowing an average of 34.6 points against Big Ten competition. The overcast conditions and modest wind should not significantly alter what figures to be a predictable matchup.
preview.prediction_writeup: Notre Dame's recent form is simply too dominant to ignore. The Irish are outscoring opponents by an average of 41.8 points per game over their last five contests, and Purdue has shown no signs of stemming that tide—the Boilermakers have lost four of five and allowed multiple opponents to exceed 40 points. Historically, this matchup heavily favors Notre Dame, which has won the last two meetings by a combined 95 points. While Purdue plays at home, the neutral weather conditions offer no particular advantage, and Purdue's defensive vulnerabilities should be exposed early by an efficient Notre Dame offense. The belt stays in South Bend.
